create materialized view public.mv_criativo_cliente as
 WITH pedidos AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.order_id) s.order_id,
            s.order_created_at::date AS data,
            TRIM(BOTH FROM s.order_customer_last_visit_utm_content) AS utm_content,
            regexp_replace(COALESCE(s.order_customer_id, ''::text), '^gid://shopify/Customer/'::text, ''::text) AS customer_id,
            s.order_total_price AS receita
           FROM stg_shopify_orders_item s
          WHERE s.order_cancelled_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(TRIM(BOTH FROM s.order_customer_last_visit_utm_content), ''::text) <> ''::text
          ORDER BY s.order_id, s._loaded_at DESC NULLS LAST
        ), anuncio_id AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT dim_meta_anuncio.ad_id
           FROM dim_meta_anuncio
          WHERE dim_meta_anuncio.ad_id IS NOT NULL
        ), anuncio_nome AS (
         SELECT lower(dim_meta_anuncio.ad_name) AS nome,
            min(dim_meta_anuncio.ad_id) AS ad_id
           FROM dim_meta_anuncio
          WHERE dim_meta_anuncio.ad_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(TRIM(BOTH FROM dim_meta_anuncio.ad_name), ''::text) <> ''::text
          GROUP BY (lower(dim_meta_anuncio.ad_name))
        ), ligados AS (
         SELECT p_1.order_id,
            p_1.data,
            p_1.customer_id,
            p_1.receita,
            COALESCE(i.ad_id, n.ad_id) AS ad_id
           FROM pedidos p_1
             LEFT JOIN anuncio_id i ON i.ad_id = p_1.utm_content
             LEFT JOIN anuncio_nome n ON n.nome = lower(p_1.utm_content)
          WHERE COALESCE(i.ad_id, n.ad_id) IS NOT NULL
        ), clientes AS (
         SELECT dim_cliente.cliente_id::text AS customer_id,
            dim_cliente.cliente_chave
           FROM dim_cliente
          WHERE dim_cliente.cliente_id IS NOT NULL
        ), com_cliente AS (
         SELECT l.order_id,
            l.data,
            l.customer_id,
            l.receita,
            l.ad_id,
            d.cliente_chave
           FROM ligados l
             LEFT JOIN clientes d ON d.customer_id = l.customer_id
        )
 SELECT c.ad_id,
    count(DISTINCT c.order_id)::integer AS pedidos,
    sum(c.receita) AS receita,
    count(DISTINCT c.cliente_chave)::integer AS clientes,
    count(DISTINCT c.cliente_chave) FILTER (WHERE p.primeira_compra = c.data)::integer AS clientes_novos,
    count(DISTINCT c.cliente_chave) FILTER (WHERE p.primeira_compra = c.data AND p.pedidos >= 2)::integer AS novos_que_recompraram,
    avg(p.valor_total) FILTER (WHERE p.primeira_compra = c.data) AS ltv_medio_novos,
    min(c.data) AS primeiro_pedido,
    max(c.data) AS ultimo_pedido,
    now() AS gerado_em
   FROM com_cliente c
     LEFT JOIN mv_growth_cliente_perfil p ON p.cliente_chave = c.cliente_chave
  GROUP BY c.ad_id;

create materialized view public.mv_cupom_cliente_qualidade as
 WITH uso AS (
         SELECT upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM s.order_discount_code)) AS cupom,
            regexp_replace(COALESCE(s.order_customer_id, ''::text), '^gid://shopify/Customer/'::text, ''::text) AS customer_id,
            min(s.order_created_at)::date AS primeiro_uso
           FROM stg_shopify_orders_item s
          WHERE COALESCE(TRIM(BOTH FROM s.order_discount_code), ''::text) <> ''::text
          GROUP BY (upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM s.order_discount_code))), (regexp_replace(COALESCE(s.order_customer_id, ''::text), '^gid://shopify/Customer/'::text, ''::text))
        ), clientes AS (
         SELECT dim_cliente.cliente_id::text AS customer_id,
            dim_cliente.cliente_chave
           FROM dim_cliente
          WHERE dim_cliente.cliente_id IS NOT NULL
        ), uso_cliente AS (
         SELECT u_1.cupom,
            d.cliente_chave,
            min(u_1.primeiro_uso) AS primeiro_uso
           FROM uso u_1
             JOIN clientes d ON d.customer_id = u_1.customer_id
          GROUP BY u_1.cupom, d.cliente_chave
        )
 SELECT u.cupom,
    count(*)::integer AS clientes,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.primeira_compra >= u.primeiro_uso)::integer AS clientes_novos,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.pedidos >= 2 AND p.ultima_compra > u.primeiro_uso)::integer AS recompraram,
    avg(p.valor_total) AS ltv_medio,
    avg(p.pedidos) AS pedidos_medio,
    now() AS gerado_em
   FROM uso_cliente u
     JOIN mv_growth_cliente_perfil p ON p.cliente_chave = u.cliente_chave
  GROUP BY u.cupom;

create materialized view public.mv_growth_acao_resumo as
 SELECT acao,
    canal_ultimo AS canal,
    acionavel,
    count(*) AS clientes,
    round(sum(valor_esperado_90), 2) AS valor_esperado,
    round(avg(chance_90), 1) AS chance_media,
    round(sum(valor_total) / NULLIF(sum(pedidos), 0::numeric), 2) AS ticket_medio,
    round(sum(valor_total), 2) AS valor_historico,
    now() AS gerado_em
   FROM mv_growth_cliente_perfil

create materialized view public.mv_growth_cac_canal_mes as

create materialized view public.mv_growth_cac_cohort as
 WITH novos AS (
         SELECT to_char(o.mes_entrada::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM'::text) AS mes,
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(o.canal_entrada), ''::text), 'Sem canal'::text) = 'Shopify'::text THEN 'Site'::text
                    ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(o.canal_entrada), ''::text), 'Sem canal'::text)
                END AS canal,
            count(*) AS novos
           FROM mv_growth_origem_cliente o
          WHERE o.mes_entrada IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY (to_char(o.mes_entrada::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM'::text)), (
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(o.canal_entrada), ''::text), 'Sem canal'::text) = 'Shopify'::text THEN 'Site'::text
                    ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(o.canal_entrada), ''::text), 'Sem canal'::text)
                END)
        ), inv AS (
         SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month'::text, v.data::timestamp with time zone), 'YYYY-MM'::text) AS mes,
                CASE
                    WHEN v.canal = 'Shopify'::text THEN 'Site'::text
                    ELSE v.canal
                END AS canal,
            sum(COALESCE(v.invest_aquisicao, 0::numeric)) AS invest_aquisicao
           FROM vw_receita_consolidada v
          WHERE v.data IS NOT NULL AND v.canal IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY (to_char(date_trunc('month'::text, v.data::timestamp with time zone), 'YYYY-MM'::text)), (
                CASE
                    WHEN v.canal = 'Shopify'::text THEN 'Site'::text
                    ELSE v.canal
                END)
        )
 SELECT COALESCE(n.mes, i.mes) AS mes,
    COALESCE(n.canal, i.canal) AS canal,
    COALESCE(n.novos, 0::bigint) AS novos,
    i.invest_aquisicao,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(n.novos, 0::bigint) > 0 AND i.invest_aquisicao IS NOT NULL AND i.invest_aquisicao > 0::numeric THEN i.invest_aquisicao / n.novos::numeric
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS cac,
    now() AS gerado_em
   FROM novos n
     FULL JOIN inv i ON i.mes = n.mes AND i.canal = n.canal;

create materialized view public.mv_growth_cliente_perfil as
 WITH ped AS (
         SELECT p.cliente_chave,
            p.canal,
            p.pedido_id,
            p.data,
            max(p.valor) AS valor
           FROM fact_pedido_cliente p
          WHERE p.cliente_chave IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY p.cliente_chave, p.canal, p.pedido_id, p.data
        ), gaps AS (
         SELECT ped.cliente_chave,
            (ped.data - lag(ped.data) OVER (PARTITION BY ped.cliente_chave ORDER BY ped.data, ped.pedido_id))::numeric AS dias
           FROM ped
        ), ritmo_cli AS (
         SELECT gaps.cliente_chave,
            percentile_cont(0.5::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (gaps.dias::double precision)) AS ritmo
           FROM gaps
          WHERE gaps.dias > 0::numeric
          GROUP BY gaps.cliente_chave
        ), base AS (
         SELECT ped.cliente_chave,
            count(*) AS pedidos,
            min(ped.data) AS primeira_compra,
            max(ped.data) AS ultima_compra,
            sum(COALESCE(ped.valor, 0::numeric)) AS valor_total,
            avg(COALESCE(ped.valor, 0::numeric)) AS ticket_medio,
            count(DISTINCT ped.canal) AS canais,
            (array_agg(ped.canal ORDER BY ped.data DESC, ped.pedido_id DESC))[1] AS canal_ultimo,
            (array_agg(ped.canal ORDER BY ped.data, ped.pedido_id))[1] AS canal_entrada
           FROM ped
          GROUP BY ped.cliente_chave
        ), ritmo_canal AS (
         SELECT b.canal_ultimo AS canal,
            percentile_cont(0.5::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r.ritmo) AS ritmo
           FROM base b
             JOIN ritmo_cli r ON r.cliente_chave = b.cliente_chave
          GROUP BY b.canal_ultimo
        ), item_cli AS (
         SELECT p.cliente_chave,
            i.sku,
            min(COALESCE(NULLIF(i.produto, ''::text), i.sku)) AS produto,
            count(*) AS vezes,
            sum(COALESCE(i.valor_total, 0::numeric)) AS receita,
            max(p.data) AS ultima
           FROM fact_pedido_item_cliente i
             JOIN ped p ON p.canal = i.canal AND p.pedido_id = i.pedido_id
          WHERE i.sku IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY p.cliente_chave, i.sku
        ), item_top AS (
         SELECT t.cliente_chave,
            t.sku,
            t.produto,
            t.vezes
           FROM ( SELECT ic.cliente_chave,
                    ic.sku,
                    ic.produto,
                    ic.vezes,
                    ic.receita,
                    ic.ultima,
                    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY ic.cliente_chave ORDER BY ic.vezes DESC, ic.receita DESC, ic.ultima DESC, ic.sku) AS pos
                   FROM item_cli ic) t
          WHERE t.pos = 1
        ), calc AS (
         SELECT b.cliente_chave,
            b.pedidos,
            b.primeira_compra,
            b.ultima_compra,
            b.valor_total,
            b.ticket_medio,
            b.canais,
            b.canal_ultimo,
            b.canal_entrada,
            it.sku AS sku_principal,
            it.produto AS produto_principal,
            COALESCE(rc.ritmo, pc.ciclo_mediano::numeric::double precision, rcanal.ritmo, 68::double precision)::numeric AS ritmo,
            rc.ritmo IS NOT NULL AS ritmo_proprio,
            (CURRENT_DATE - b.ultima_compra)::numeric AS dias_ultima,
            prox.sku_seguinte,
            prox.produto_seguinte
           FROM base b
             LEFT JOIN ritmo_cli rc ON rc.cliente_chave = b.cliente_chave
             LEFT JOIN item_top it ON it.cliente_chave = b.cliente_chave
             LEFT JOIN mv_growth_produto_ciclo pc ON pc.sku = it.sku
             LEFT JOIN ritmo_canal rcanal ON rcanal.canal = b.canal_ultimo
             LEFT JOIN mv_growth_produto_proximo prox ON prox.sku_origem = it.sku AND prox.pos = 1
        ), prob AS (
         SELECT c.cliente_chave,
            c.pedidos,
            c.primeira_compra,
            c.ultima_compra,
            c.valor_total,
            c.ticket_medio,
            c.canais,
            c.canal_ultimo,
            c.canal_entrada,
            c.sku_principal,
            c.produto_principal,
            c.ritmo,
            c.ritmo_proprio,
            c.dias_ultima,
            c.sku_seguinte,
            c.produto_seguinte,
            c.dias_ultima / NULLIF(c.ritmo, 0::numeric) AS razao,
            growth_prob_recompra(c.ritmo, c.dias_ultima, c.pedidos::integer, c.canais::integer, 30) AS p30,
            growth_prob_recompra(c.ritmo, c.dias_ultima, c.pedidos::integer, c.canais::integer, 60) AS p60,
            growth_prob_recompra(c.ritmo, c.dias_ultima, c.pedidos::integer, c.canais::integer, 90) AS p90
           FROM calc c
        )
 SELECT cliente_chave,
    pedidos,
    primeira_compra,
    ultima_compra,
    round(valor_total, 2) AS valor_total,
    round(ticket_medio, 2) AS ticket_medio,
    canais,
    canal_ultimo,
    canal_entrada,
    sku_principal,
    produto_principal,
    round(ritmo)::integer AS ritmo_dias,
    ritmo_proprio,
    dias_ultima::integer AS dias_ultima_compra,
    round(razao, 2) AS razao_ritmo,
    GREATEST(0::numeric, round(dias_ultima - ritmo))::integer AS dias_atraso,
    round(100::numeric * p30, 1) AS chance_30,
    round(100::numeric * p60, 1) AS chance_60,
    round(100::numeric * p90, 1) AS chance_90,
    round(p90 * ticket_medio, 2) AS valor_esperado_90,
    round(valor_total + p90 * ticket_medio, 2) AS ltv_esperado,
        CASE
            WHEN pedidos = 1 AND razao <= 1.6 THEN 'segunda_compra'::text
            WHEN valor_total >= 1000::numeric AND razao > 1.6 AND razao <= 4::numeric THEN 'valioso_em_risco'::text
            WHEN razao < 0.7 THEN 'aguardar'::text
            WHEN razao <= 1.6 THEN 'recompra'::text
            WHEN razao <= 3::numeric THEN 'resgate'::text
            ELSE 'reativacao'::text
        END AS acao,
        CASE
            WHEN canal_ultimo = ANY (ARRAY['Shopify'::text, 'Site'::text, 'TikTok'::text]) THEN 'direto'::text
            ELSE 'midia'::text
        END AS acionavel,
        CASE
            WHEN pedidos > 1 THEN COALESCE(sku_principal, sku_seguinte)
            ELSE COALESCE(sku_seguinte, sku_principal)
        END AS sku_provavel,
        CASE
            WHEN pedidos > 1 THEN COALESCE(produto_principal, produto_seguinte)
            ELSE COALESCE(produto_seguinte, produto_principal)
        END AS produto_provavel,
    now() AS gerado_em
   FROM prob;

create materialized view public.mv_growth_cliente_primeira as

   FROM vw_cliente_pedidos
  WHERE cliente_id IS NOT NULL AND data IS NOT NULL

create materialized view public.mv_growth_cohort_canal_mes as
 WITH base AS (
         SELECT o.cliente_chave,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(o.canal_entrada), ''::text), 'Sem canal'::text) AS canal_entrada,
            to_char(o.mes_entrada::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM'::text) AS safra,
            o.mes_entrada
           FROM mv_growth_origem_cliente o
          WHERE o.cliente_chave IS NOT NULL AND o.mes_entrada IS NOT NULL
        ), tam AS (
         SELECT base.safra,
            base.canal_entrada,
            count(*) AS clientes_safra
           FROM base
          GROUP BY base.safra, base.canal_entrada
        ), ped AS (
         SELECT f.cliente_chave,
            date_trunc('month'::text, f.data::timestamp with time zone)::date AS mes,
            COALESCE(f.valor, 0::numeric) AS valor
           FROM fact_pedido_cliente f
          WHERE f.cliente_chave IS NOT NULL AND f.data IS NOT NULL
        )
 SELECT b.safra,
    b.canal_entrada,
    (EXTRACT(year FROM p.mes) - EXTRACT(year FROM b.mes_entrada))::integer * 12 + (EXTRACT(month FROM p.mes) - EXTRACT(month FROM b.mes_entrada))::integer AS mes_offset,
    max(t.clientes_safra) AS clientes_safra,
    count(DISTINCT p.cliente_chave) AS clientes,
    count(*) AS pedidos,
    sum(p.valor) AS receita,
    now() AS gerado_em
   FROM base b
     JOIN ped p ON p.cliente_chave = b.cliente_chave
     JOIN tam t ON t.safra = b.safra AND t.canal_entrada = b.canal_entrada
  GROUP BY b.safra, b.canal_entrada, ((EXTRACT(year FROM p.mes) - EXTRACT(year FROM b.mes_entrada))::integer * 12 + (EXTRACT(month FROM p.mes) - EXTRACT(month FROM b.mes_entrada))::integer);

create materialized view public.mv_growth_cohort_mes as
 WITH p AS (
         SELECT vw_cliente_pedidos.cliente_id,
            date_trunc('month'::text, vw_cliente_pedidos.data::timestamp with time zone) AS mes,
            COALESCE(vw_cliente_pedidos.valor, 0::numeric) AS valor
           FROM vw_cliente_pedidos
          WHERE vw_cliente_pedidos.cliente_id IS NOT NULL AND vw_cliente_pedidos.data IS NOT NULL
        ), f AS (
         SELECT p_1.cliente_id,
            min(p_1.mes) AS safra
           FROM p p_1
          GROUP BY p_1.cliente_id
        ), tam AS (
         SELECT f_1.safra,
            count(*) AS clientes_safra
           FROM f f_1
          GROUP BY f_1.safra
        )
 SELECT to_char(f.safra, 'YYYY-MM'::text) AS safra,
    (EXTRACT(year FROM p.mes) - EXTRACT(year FROM f.safra))::integer * 12 + (EXTRACT(month FROM p.mes) - EXTRACT(month FROM f.safra))::integer AS mes_offset,
    max(tam.clientes_safra) AS clientes_safra,
    count(DISTINCT p.cliente_id) AS clientes,
    count(*) AS pedidos,
    sum(p.valor) AS receita,
    now() AS gerado_em
   FROM p
     JOIN f ON f.cliente_id = p.cliente_id
     JOIN tam ON tam.safra = f.safra
  GROUP BY (to_char(f.safra, 'YYYY-MM'::text)), ((EXTRACT(year FROM p.mes) - EXTRACT(year FROM f.safra))::integer * 12 + (EXTRACT(month FROM p.mes) - EXTRACT(month FROM f.safra))::integer);

create materialized view public.mv_growth_ltv_canal as
 WITH p AS (
         SELECT vw_cliente_pedidos.cliente_id,
            vw_cliente_pedidos.data,
            vw_cliente_pedidos.canal,
            COALESCE(vw_cliente_pedidos.valor, 0::numeric) AS valor
           FROM vw_cliente_pedidos
          WHERE vw_cliente_pedidos.cliente_id IS NOT NULL AND vw_cliente_pedidos.data IS NOT NULL
        ), origem AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (p_1.cliente_id) p_1.cliente_id,
            COALESCE(p_1.canal, 'Sem canal'::text) AS canal
           FROM p p_1
          ORDER BY p_1.cliente_id, p_1.data
        )
 SELECT o.canal,
    count(DISTINCT p.cliente_id) AS clientes,
    count(*) AS pedidos,
    sum(p.valor) AS receita,
    now() AS gerado_em
   FROM p
     JOIN origem o ON o.cliente_id = p.cliente_id
  GROUP BY o.canal;

create materialized view public.mv_growth_mes as
 WITH p AS (
         SELECT vw_cliente_pedidos.cliente_id,
            date_trunc('month'::text, vw_cliente_pedidos.data::timestamp with time zone) AS mes,
            COALESCE(vw_cliente_pedidos.valor, 0::numeric) AS valor
           FROM vw_cliente_pedidos
          WHERE vw_cliente_pedidos.data IS NOT NULL
        ), f AS (
         SELECT p_1.cliente_id,
            min(p_1.mes) AS safra
           FROM p p_1
          WHERE p_1.cliente_id IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY p_1.cliente_id
        )
 SELECT to_char(p.mes, 'YYYY-MM'::text) AS mes,
    sum(p.valor) AS receita,
    count(*) AS pedidos,
    count(DISTINCT p.cliente_id) AS clientes,
    count(DISTINCT p.cliente_id) FILTER (WHERE f.safra = p.mes) AS novos,
    count(DISTINCT p.cliente_id) FILTER (WHERE f.safra < p.mes) AS recorrentes,
    now() AS gerado_em
   FROM p
     LEFT JOIN f ON f.cliente_id = p.cliente_id
  GROUP BY (to_char(p.mes, 'YYYY-MM'::text));

create materialized view public.mv_growth_origem_campanha as
 SELECT COALESCE(origem_entrada, 'nao informado'::text) AS origem_entrada,
    COALESCE(campanha_entrada, 'sem campanha'::text) AS campanha_entrada,
    count(*) AS clientes,
    sum(pedidos)::bigint AS pedidos,
    sum(receita) AS receita,
    sum(receita) / NULLIF(count(*), 0)::numeric AS ltv_medio,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE pedidos > 1) AS recompradores,
    now() AS gerado_em
   FROM mv_growth_origem_cliente
  WHERE canal_entrada = 'Shopify'::text
  GROUP BY (COALESCE(origem_entrada, 'nao informado'::text)), (COALESCE(campanha_entrada, 'sem campanha'::text));

create materialized view public.mv_growth_origem_canal as
 SELECT canal_entrada,
    count(*) AS clientes,
    sum(pedidos)::bigint AS pedidos,
    sum(receita) AS receita,
    sum(receita) / NULLIF(count(*), 0)::numeric AS ltv_medio,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE pedidos > 1) AS recompradores,
    100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE pedidos > 1)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0)::numeric AS pct_recompra,
    min(data_entrada) AS primeira_entrada,
    max(data_entrada) AS ultima_entrada,
    now() AS gerado_em
   FROM mv_growth_origem_cliente
  GROUP BY canal_entrada;

create materialized view public.mv_growth_origem_cliente as
 WITH primeiro AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (f.cliente_chave) f.cliente_chave,
            f.pedido_id,
            f.canal AS canal_entrada,
            f.data AS data_entrada
           FROM fact_pedido_cliente f
          WHERE f.cliente_chave IS NOT NULL AND f.data IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY f.cliente_chave, f.data, f.pedido_id
        ), shop AS (
         SELECT s.order_id AS pedido_id,
            max(NULLIF(btrim(s.order_customer_last_visit_source), ''::text)) AS origem,
            max(NULLIF(btrim(s.order_customer_last_visit_utm_source), ''::text)) AS utm_source,
            max(NULLIF(btrim(s.order_customer_last_visit_utm_medium), ''::text)) AS utm_medium,
            max(NULLIF(btrim(s.order_customer_last_visit_utm_campaign), ''::text)) AS utm_campaign
           FROM stg_shopify_orders_item s
          GROUP BY s.order_id
        ), tot AS (

           FROM fact_pedido_cliente
          WHERE fact_pedido_cliente.cliente_chave IS NOT NULL

        )
 SELECT p.cliente_chave,
    p.canal_entrada,
    p.data_entrada,
    date_trunc('month'::text, p.data_entrada::timestamp with time zone)::date AS mes_entrada,
        CASE

        END AS midia_entrada,
    t.pedidos,

create materialized view public.mv_growth_produto_ciclo as
 WITH ped AS (
         SELECT p.cliente_chave,
            p.canal,
            p.pedido_id,
            p.data
           FROM fact_pedido_cliente p
          WHERE p.cliente_chave IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY p.cliente_chave, p.canal, p.pedido_id, p.data
        ), item AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT p.cliente_chave,
            i.sku,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(i.produto, ''::text), i.sku) AS produto,
            p.data
           FROM fact_pedido_item_cliente i
             JOIN ped p ON p.canal = i.canal AND p.pedido_id = i.pedido_id
          WHERE i.sku IS NOT NULL
        ), seq AS (
         SELECT item.sku,
            item.produto,
            item.cliente_chave,
            item.data,
            lead(item.data) OVER (PARTITION BY item.sku, item.cliente_chave ORDER BY item.data) AS proxima
           FROM item
        ), calc AS (
         SELECT seq.sku,
            min(seq.produto) AS produto,
            count(DISTINCT seq.cliente_chave) AS clientes,
            count(*) AS compras,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE seq.proxima IS NOT NULL AND seq.proxima > seq.data) AS recompras,
            percentile_cont(0.5::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (
                CASE
                    WHEN seq.proxima > seq.data THEN (seq.proxima - seq.data)::numeric
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END::double precision)) AS ciclo_mediano,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE seq.proxima IS NOT NULL AND (seq.proxima - seq.data) <= 30) AS r30,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE seq.proxima IS NOT NULL AND (seq.proxima - seq.data) <= 60) AS r60,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE seq.proxima IS NOT NULL AND (seq.proxima - seq.data) <= 90) AS r90,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE seq.data <= (CURRENT_DATE - 30)) AS base30,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE seq.data <= (CURRENT_DATE - 60)) AS base60,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE seq.data <= (CURRENT_DATE - 90)) AS base90
           FROM seq
          GROUP BY seq.sku
        )
 SELECT sku,
    produto,
    clientes,
    compras,
    recompras,
    round(ciclo_mediano)::integer AS ciclo_mediano,
    round(100.0 * r30::numeric / NULLIF(base30, 0)::numeric, 2) AS pct_retorno_30,
    round(100.0 * r60::numeric / NULLIF(base60, 0)::numeric, 2) AS pct_retorno_60,
    round(100.0 * r90::numeric / NULLIF(base90, 0)::numeric, 2) AS pct_retorno_90,
    now() AS gerado_em
   FROM calc
  WHERE compras >= 5;

create materialized view public.mv_growth_produto_proximo as
 WITH ped AS (
         SELECT p.cliente_chave,
            p.canal,
            p.pedido_id,
            p.data
           FROM fact_pedido_cliente p
          WHERE p.cliente_chave IS NOT NULL AND p.data >= (CURRENT_DATE - 540)
          GROUP BY p.cliente_chave, p.canal, p.pedido_id, p.data
        ), item AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT p.cliente_chave,
            i.sku,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(i.produto, ''::text), i.sku) AS produto,
            p.data
           FROM fact_pedido_item_cliente i
             JOIN ped p ON p.canal = i.canal AND p.pedido_id = i.pedido_id
          WHERE i.sku IS NOT NULL
        ), multi AS (
         SELECT item.cliente_chave
           FROM item
          GROUP BY item.cliente_chave
         HAVING count(DISTINCT item.data) > 1
        ), item_m AS (
         SELECT i.cliente_chave,
            i.sku,
            i.produto,
            i.data
           FROM item i
             JOIN multi m ON m.cliente_chave = i.cliente_chave
        ), par AS (
         SELECT a.sku AS sku_origem,
            b.sku AS sku_seguinte,
            min(b.produto) AS produto_seguinte,
            count(*) AS ocorrencias
           FROM item_m a
             JOIN item_m b ON b.cliente_chave = a.cliente_chave AND b.data > a.data AND b.data <= (a.data + 180)
          GROUP BY a.sku, b.sku
        ), tot AS (
         SELECT par.sku_origem,
            sum(par.ocorrencias) AS total
           FROM par
          GROUP BY par.sku_origem
        ), rank_par AS (
         SELECT par.sku_origem,
            par.sku_seguinte,
            par.produto_seguinte,
            par.ocorrencias,
            round(100.0 * par.ocorrencias::numeric / NULLIF(tot.total, 0::numeric), 2) AS forca_pct,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY par.sku_origem ORDER BY par.ocorrencias DESC, par.sku_seguinte) AS pos
           FROM par
             JOIN tot ON tot.sku_origem = par.sku_origem
          WHERE par.ocorrencias >= 5
        )
 SELECT sku_origem,
    sku_seguinte,
    produto_seguinte,
    ocorrencias,

create materialized view public.mv_growth_recompra_acuracia as
 WITH ped AS (
         SELECT p.cliente_chave,
            p.canal,
            p.pedido_id,
            p.data
           FROM fact_pedido_cliente p
          WHERE p.cliente_chave IS NOT NULL AND p.data >= (CURRENT_DATE - 800)
          GROUP BY p.cliente_chave, p.canal, p.pedido_id, p.data
        ), safra AS (
         SELECT s.h
           FROM ( VALUES (30), (60), (90)) s(h)
        ), estado AS (
         SELECT s.h,
            p.cliente_chave,
            count(*) AS pedidos,
            max(p.data) AS ultima,
            count(DISTINCT p.canal) AS canais
           FROM safra s
             JOIN ped p ON p.data <= (CURRENT_DATE - s.h)
          GROUP BY s.h, p.cliente_chave
        ), gaps AS (
         SELECT s.h,
            p.cliente_chave,
            (p.data - lag(p.data) OVER (PARTITION BY s.h, p.cliente_chave ORDER BY p.data, p.pedido_id))::numeric AS dias
           FROM safra s
             JOIN ped p ON p.data <= (CURRENT_DATE - s.h)
        ), ritmo AS (
         SELECT gaps.h,
            gaps.cliente_chave,
            percentile_cont(0.5::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (gaps.dias::double precision)) AS ritmo
           FROM gaps
          WHERE gaps.dias > 0::numeric
          GROUP BY gaps.h, gaps.cliente_chave
        ), previsto AS (
         SELECT e.h,
            e.cliente_chave,
            growth_prob_recompra(COALESCE(r.ritmo, 68::double precision)::numeric, (CURRENT_DATE - e.h - e.ultima)::numeric, e.pedidos::integer, e.canais::integer, e.h) AS p
           FROM estado e
             LEFT JOIN ritmo r ON r.h = e.h AND r.cliente_chave = e.cliente_chave
          WHERE e.ultima >= (CURRENT_DATE - e.h - 365)
        ), realizado AS (
         SELECT s.h,
            p.cliente_chave
           FROM safra s
             JOIN ped p ON p.data > (CURRENT_DATE - s.h)
          GROUP BY s.h, p.cliente_chave
        )
 SELECT pv.h AS horizonte_dias,

create materialized view public.mv_growth_rfm_segmento as
 WITH base AS (
         SELECT vw_cliente_lista.cliente_id,
            CURRENT_DATE - vw_cliente_lista.ultima_compra AS recencia,
            COALESCE(vw_cliente_lista.pedidos, 0::bigint) AS frequencia,
            COALESCE(vw_cliente_lista.faturamento, 0::numeric) AS monetario
           FROM vw_cliente_lista
          WHERE vw_cliente_lista.cliente_id IS NOT NULL AND vw_cliente_lista.ultima_compra IS NOT NULL
        ), notas AS (
         SELECT base.recencia,
            base.frequencia,
            base.monetario,
            6 - ntile(5) OVER (ORDER BY base.recencia) AS r,
            ntile(5) OVER (ORDER BY base.frequencia) AS f,
            ntile(5) OVER (ORDER BY base.monetario) AS m
           FROM base
        ), seg AS (
         SELECT notas.recencia,
            notas.frequencia,
            notas.monetario,
            notas.r,
            notas.f,
            notas.m,
                CASE
                    WHEN notas.r >= 4 AND notas.f >= 4 THEN 'Campe├Áes'::text
                    WHEN notas.r >= 3 AND notas.f >= 3 THEN 'Fi├®is'::text
                    WHEN notas.r >= 4 AND notas.f <= 2 THEN 'Novos'::text
                    WHEN notas.r = 3 AND notas.f <= 2 THEN 'Promissores'::text
                    WHEN notas.r <= 2 AND (notas.f >= 3 OR notas.m >= 4) THEN 'Em risco'::text
                    WHEN notas.r <= 2 AND notas.f <= 2 THEN 'Perdidos'::text
                    ELSE 'Aten├º├úo'::text
                END AS segmento
           FROM notas
        )
 SELECT segmento,
    count(*) AS clientes,
    sum(monetario) AS receita,
    avg(recencia) AS recencia_media,
    avg(frequencia) AS frequencia_media,
    sum(monetario) / NULLIF(count(*), 0)::numeric AS ticket_medio,
    now() AS gerado_em
   FROM seg
  GROUP BY segmento;

    round(invest_ads, 2) AS invest_ads,
    round(receita_ads, 2) AS receita_ads,
    round(receita_ads / NULLIF(invest_ads, 0::numeric), 2) AS roas,
    round(100.0 * receita_ads / NULLIF(receita, 0::numeric), 1) AS share_ads_pct,
    round(100.0 * invest_ads / NULLIF(receita, 0::numeric), 1) AS tacos_pct
   FROM juntos
  WHERE unidades <> 0::numeric OR invest_ads <> 0::numeric;

create materialized view public.mv_site_pedido_pagina_dia as
 WITH ped AS (
         SELECT stg_shopify_orders_item.date AS data,
            regexp_replace('/'::text || regexp_replace(split_part(split_part(stg_shopify_orders_item.order_customer_last_visit_landing_page, '?'::text, 1), '://'::text, 2), '^[^/]+/'::text, ''::text), '/+$'::text, ''::text) AS pagina_path,
            COALESCE(stg_shopify_orders_item.order_customer_last_visit_utm_source, ''::text) AS utm_source,
            COALESCE(stg_shopify_orders_item.order_customer_last_visit_utm_medium, ''::text) AS utm_medium,
            stg_shopify_orders_item.order_id,
            sum(COALESCE(stg_shopify_orders_item.line_item__net_sales, 0::numeric)) AS receita_pedido,
            sum(COALESCE(stg_shopify_orders_item.line_item__quantity, 0::numeric)) AS unidades_pedido
           FROM stg_shopify_orders_item
          WHERE stg_shopify_orders_item.order_customer_last_visit_landing_page IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(stg_shopify_orders_item.order_test, false) = false AND (stg_shopify_orders_item.order_customer_last_visit_landing_page ~~* '%/pages/%'::text OR stg_shopify_orders_item.order_customer_last_visit_landing_page ~~* '%/products/%'::text) AND stg_shopify_orders_item.date >= '2026-08-01'::date
          GROUP BY stg_shopify_orders_item.date, (regexp_replace('/'::text || regexp_replace(split_part(split_part(stg_shopify_orders_item.order_customer_last_visit_landing_page, '?'::text, 1), '://'::text, 2), '^[^/]+/'::text, ''::text), '/+$'::text, ''::text)), (COALESCE(stg_shopify_orders_item.order_customer_last_visit_utm_source, ''::text)), (COALESCE(stg_shopify_orders_item.order_customer_last_visit_utm_medium, ''::text)), stg_shopify_orders_item.order_id
        )
 SELECT data,
    pagina_path,
    utm_source,
    utm_medium,
    count(DISTINCT order_id)::integer AS pedidos,
    round(sum(receita_pedido), 2) AS receita,
    sum(unidades_pedido)::integer AS unidades
   FROM ped
  GROUP BY data, pagina_path, utm_source, utm_medium;
